About the studio

More than pictures. Stories worth keeping.

Wise Pro Studios is a photography and videography studio based in Ruwa, Zimbabwe. From weddings and maroro to graduations and portraits, we shape every session around you — relaxed, polished and true to your story.

FAQ

Good to know

Do I need to book?

Yes. Wise Pro Studios is appointment only, so please book in advance.

Where are you based?

We’re in Ruwa, Zimbabwe, and shoot at the studio and on location.

What do you shoot?

Weddings, maroro, lobola events, graduations, portraits, sports, school events, birthdays and more.

Can I get prints or an album?

Yes — canvas, prints, albums, frames and gifts are all available.
